overview.title: General Settings
overview.description: Settings that apply to all bot commands.
overview.globalEnabledHelp: Disabling this turns off all bot commands in the server (except owner commands).
overview.bypassOwnerHelp: Server owner can use all commands even if disabled or role-restricted.
overview.bypassAdminHelp: Members with Manage Server permission can use all admin commands even if restricted.
